summary: One huge table (about 6,600 rows) listing every console variable with its default value and a one-line description, grouped by system: Animation, Audio (au.*), Blueprint, Enhanced Input, Niagara (fx.*), Physics (p.*), Networking, Scalability (sg.*), Show Flags, Slate/UMG, World Partition, and a big Rendering section with sub-tables for Lumen, Nanite, Shadow/VSM, Ray Tracing, TSR, Streaming and more. Use it to look up what a cvar does and what it defaults to when tuning performance or quality in the editor or DefaultEngine.ini.
gotchas: Reference table only: name, default and short description, with no usage guidance; some rows have no description
r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing: hardware ray tracing has large scene update costs above about 100k instances; Lumen falls back to software tracing when HWRT is unavailable
Several cvars are marked experimental, e.g. r.Nanite.Tessellation / r.Nanite.AllowTessellation, r.RayTracing.EnableOnDemand, r.Shadow.FilterMethod=1 (PCSS); r.Substrate is Beta
Some cvars are deprecated and point to replacements, e.g. r.BasePassOutputsVelocity -> r.VelocityOutputPass, a.SkeletalMesh.ISPC -> a.SkinnedAsset.ISPC
